description: Instantiate a registry component into a model and store the result as a NEW content-addressed model you own (lineage recorded when composing onto an existing id). Omit id to start a model from the component alone; pass attach to fuse a component port onto one of the model's existing places (e.g. attach {"queue": "tickets_queue"} wires a hazard onto the service's queue). Prefix namespaces the created elements (defaults to the component name). Three calls build a working helpdesk: arrivals, then service attached to its queue, then hazard attached to the same queue — the result passes diagnose because the discipline is in the template.

attach.description: JSON object mapping port name -> existing place id

id.description: model to compose onto; omit to start fresh

name.description: model name for the stored result (kept from the base when composing onto an id)

params.description: JSON object overriding param defaults, e.g. {"staff": 3}

prefix.description: instance prefix for created elements (default: component name)

name: sim_compose
